content.short: Gearbox improves capital efficiency by enabling Credit Accounts that give users leverage on any protocol.
content.description: Gearbox enables capital efficiency in DeFi through Credit Accounts, isolated smart contracts with predefined, whitelisted parameters such as liquidation thresholds and approved tokens. Each Credit Account can hold user funds alongside borrowed margin funds and can be deployed across any DeFi protocol. Because these accounts are non-custodial, users retain full ownership of their assets while interacting with leveraged or funded strategies. This structure enables borrowing with defined parameters, modular exposure, and cross-protocol activity within decentralized finance.
